title: Father Holding Baby in Sunny Garden, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black-and-white snapshot capturing a father gently holding up his infant baby who is clad only in a diaper. Positioned outdoors beside a lawn chair, the scene is set in a sunlit backyard with rock-lined garden beds and leafy trees in the background, reflecting typical everyday domestic family life in the postwar era. The print features classic deckled scalloped borders.
